tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Screen background behind the cards. Quiet grey so white cards read as objects without borders.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, the tab bar pill, round header buttons, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Panels inside a card (Spent / Income split, rows), keypad keys, unselected pills.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, round-button outlines, progress tracks, future chart bars, gauge hatching.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the whole-number part of amounts.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, dates, subtitles, axis text. 4.5:1 on canvas, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Cents and currency codes on amounts 24px and larger only (3:1 rule for large text). Never for small text.

tokens.name: cobalt
tokens.usage: The accent: active tab icon, selected bar, links, primary buttons, gauge start. As text on surface or cobalt-soft.

tokens.name: on-cobalt
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a cobalt fill.

tokens.name: cobalt-soft
tokens.usage: Active tab circle, selected chip, soft buttons, chart bars before the selected day.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Only the far end of the gauge arc and the streak card's glow. Never text, never a flat fill.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: The streak card: the one dark hero card on a screen. Text on it is white.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text, filled streak days and the Log today button on the deep card.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the deep card ('days in a row', weekday letters). 8:1 on deep.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The round + button beside the tab bar, and the strongest buttons (Save). Inverts in dark.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Icon and text on an action fill.

tokens.name: gain
tokens.usage: Money in, gains, paid off: '+12.6%' badges (solid with on-signal text), '+KES 1,540' text.

tokens.name: loss
tokens.usage: Overdue, over budget, losses: '−1.6%' text, Failed / Overdue badges. Always with a sign or a word.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on solid gain and loss badges.

tokens.name: gain-soft
tokens.usage: Tile behind an on-track budget.

tokens.name: loss-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an overdue row, tile behind an over-budget category.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Budget at 80–99%, due within 3 days. Text or fill on surface.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tile behind a nearly-spent budget.

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The card's headline number. Cents and currency in ink-faint.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One giant figure per screen: the streak count, a gauge percentage.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Secondary figures in split panels (Spent / Income, Owed / Owe).

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between pills and stacked text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards in a stack.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen gutter and card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a card's headline and its chart.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Keypad keys, small panels.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels inside cards, rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards and bottom sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tab bar, round buttons, badges, pills, bars.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: The tab bar, the + button and its pills, bottom sheets. Cards themselves are flat.
